title: if I had known ... / I wish I had known ...

theory.title: if I had known ... / I wish I had known ...

blocks.h: A · if + had + V3, would have + V3: điều không xảy ra ở quá khứ

ex.en: If I'd **seen** you, I **would have said** hello.
ex.vi: Nếu tôi thấy bạn, tôi đã chào rồi.

ex.en: They **would have gone** out if they **hadn't been** so tired.
ex.vi: Họ đã đi chơi nếu họ không quá mệt.

ex.en: If you'd been looking where you were going, you **wouldn't have walked** into the wall.
ex.vi: Nếu bạn nhìn đường, bạn đã không đâm vào tường.

ex.en: I **would have taken** pictures if I'd **had** a camera.
ex.vi: Tôi đã chụp ảnh nếu tôi có máy ảnh.

blocks.h: B · I wish + had + V3: tiếc về quá khứ

ex.en: I **wish I'd known** about the party. I'd have gone.
ex.vi: Ước gì tôi biết về bữa tiệc. Tôi đã đi rồi.

ex.en: I feel sick. I **wish I hadn't eaten** so much.
ex.vi: Tôi thấy buồn nôn. Ước gì tôi đã không ăn nhiều đến vậy.

ex.en: Do you **wish you'd studied** science instead of languages?
ex.vi: Bạn có tiếc là đã không học khoa học thay vì ngôn ngữ không?

blocks.p: Không dùng would have sau wish.

blocks.h: C · Kết hợp loại 3 và loại 2

ex.en: If I'd **gone** to the party last night, I **would be** tired now.
ex.vi: Nếu tối qua tôi đi dự tiệc thì giờ tôi đã mệt.

ex.en: If the weather hadn't been bad, we **could have gone** out.
ex.vi: Nếu thời tiết không xấu, chúng tôi đã có thể ra ngoài.
ex.note: (could have, might have cũng dùng được)

exercises.title: Write sentences beginning If
exercises.instr: Viết câu điều kiện loại 3 (hoặc loại 3 + loại 2) theo gợi ý.

items.context: The accident happened because the road was icy.
items.hint: if / the road / not / be icy / the accident / not / happen
items.answer: If the road hadn't been icy, the accident wouldn't have happened.
items.vi: Nếu đường không có băng thì tai nạn đã không xảy ra.
items.exp: if + hadn't been, wouldn't have happened

items.context: I didn't know you had to get up early, so I didn't wake you.
items.hint: if / I / know / you had to get up early / I / wake you
items.answer: If I'd known you had to get up early, I would have woken you.
alts: If I had known you had to get up early, I would have woken you.
If I'd known you had to get up early, I'd have woken you.
items.vi: Nếu tôi biết bạn phải dậy sớm, tôi đã gọi bạn dậy.
items.exp: if + had known, would have woken

items.context: I lost my phone, so I couldn't call you.
items.hint: if / I / not / lose my phone / I / call you
items.answer: If I hadn't lost my phone, I could have called you.
alts: If I hadn't lost my phone, I would have called you.
items.vi: Nếu tôi không mất điện thoại, tôi đã gọi cho bạn.
items.exp: if + hadn't lost, could have called

items.context: Karen wasn't injured because she was wearing a seat belt.
items.hint: if / she / not / wear a seat belt / she / be injured
items.answer: If she hadn't been wearing a seat belt, she would have been injured.
alts: If she hadn't been wearing a seat belt, she'd have been injured.
items.vi: Nếu cô ấy không thắt dây an toàn, cô ấy đã bị thương.
items.exp: if + hadn't been wearing, would have been injured

items.context: You didn't have breakfast, which is why you're hungry now.
items.hint: if / you / have breakfast / you / not / be hungry now
items.answer: If you'd had breakfast, you wouldn't be hungry now.
alts: If you had had breakfast, you wouldn't be hungry now.
items.vi: Nếu bạn đã ăn sáng, bây giờ bạn đã không đói.

items.context: I didn't get a taxi because I didn't have enough money.
items.hint: if / I / have enough money / I / get a taxi
items.answer: If I'd had enough money, I would have got a taxi.
alts: If I'd had enough money, I'd have got a taxi.
If I had had enough money, I would have got a taxi.
If I'd had enough money, I would have gotten a taxi.
items.vi: Nếu có đủ tiền, tôi đã đi taxi.
items.exp: if + had had, would have got

items.context: Dan didn't do well at school, so he couldn't go to university.
items.hint: if / Dan / do well at school / he / go to university
items.answer: If Dan had done well at school, he could have gone to university.
alts: If Dan had done well at school, he would have gone to university.
items.vi: Nếu Dan học giỏi ở trường, anh ấy đã có thể vào đại học.
items.exp: if + had done, could have gone

exercises.title: I wish …
exercises.instr: Viết câu với I wish + had / hadn't + V3 theo tình huống.

items.context: You've eaten too much and now feel sick.
items.hint: I wish / I / not / eat so much
items.answer: I wish I hadn't eaten so much.
items.vi: Ước gì tôi đã không ăn nhiều như vậy.

items.context: When you were younger, you never learned a musical instrument.
items.hint: I wish / I / learn to play a musical instrument
items.answer: I wish I had learned to play a musical instrument.
alts: I wish I'd learned to play a musical instrument.
I wish I had learnt to play a musical instrument.
I wish I'd learnt to play a musical instrument.
items.vi: Ước gì tôi đã học chơi một nhạc cụ.

items.context: You painted the gate red. Now you think it looks bad.
items.hint: I wish / I / not / paint it red
items.answer: I wish I hadn't painted it red.
items.vi: Ước gì tôi đã không sơn nó màu đỏ.

items.context: You travelled by car, but going by train would have been better.
items.hint: I wish / we / go by train
items.answer: I wish we had gone by train.
alts: I wish we'd gone by train.
items.vi: Ước gì chúng ta đã đi bằng tàu.

items.context: In New York you didn't have time to do all the things you wanted.
items.hint: I wish / we / have more time
items.answer: I wish we had had more time.
alts: I wish we'd had more time.
items.vi: Ước gì chúng ta đã có nhiều thời gian hơn.

items.context: You moved to a new flat — now you don't like it.
alts: I wish I hadn't moved to this flat.
items.vi: Ước gì tôi đã không chuyển nhà.
